title: Bug : Profile % doesn't change back
symptom: After an automation triggers a temporary target and low profile for 15 minutes, the profile percentage stays stuck at the low value and does not revert to normal after the duration ends. It requires manual reset.
fix: The issue was resolved after force closing AAPS, clearing cache, clearing APS results, and cleaning (not resetting) the database in AAPS. The user is unsure which action helped.
evidence_quote: I'm closing this issue as all started working ok as before. FYI, this is what I did ( but have no idea if one of these helped...) Force close AAPS and clear cache. Clear APS results and clean (not _reset_ ) db in AAPS.
